<includeonly>[[Main:{{{1|}}}|{{{2|{{{1|}}}}}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>
Simple template for linking to mainspace from an article in a versioned namespace, particularly for redirects only existing in the mainspace. For example, [[kitten]] (<code><nowiki>[[kitten]]</nowiki></code>) works here, but not in a DF2012 article - you need to use [[Main:kitten|kitten]] (<code><nowiki>[[Main:kitten|kitten]]</nowiki></code>).

Usage: Similar to using double-bracket syntax (2 parameters, link title is the first parameter if the second is left blank).

<pre>{{ml|kitten}}</pre>
{{ml|kitten}}
<pre>{{ml|kitten|this page}}</pre>
{{ml|kitten|this page}}

'''Note:''' <code>subst</code>ing this template will work, and is probably helpful in some cases (see {{tl|unsigned}})

==See also==
{{tl|Tl}}: A template to link to templates

</noinclude>
